fields.name: seo
fields.label: Site Identity & SEO
fields.description: Site-wide identity. These values appear on every page — the Site Name is shown in the header navigation and used as the default browser title; the Description is the default for search results and social shares.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Shown in the header navigation on every page. Lives in Global Config because it's the same site-wide — each page sets its own browser title via the Meta Title field on the page, and this Site Name is used as the fallback if a page is ever missing one.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Default description shown in search results and social-sharing previews when a page does not provide its own.

fields.name: siteOwner
fields.label: Site Owner (shown in footer)
fields.description: Your name or company name. Displayed in the site footer.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown next to the Site Name in the header navigation.

fields.name: brandSubtitle
fields.label: Brokerage Subtitle
fields.description: Small line under the site name in the header and footer (e.g. "eXp Realty").

fields.name: socialImage
fields.label: Default Social Share Image
fields.description: Fallback Open Graph/Twitter card image for pages that don't set their own.

fields.name: headerCta
fields.label: Header Button
fields.description: The red button at the right end of the header navigation (desktop and mobile menu).

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: e.g. /contact-us/

fields.name: preferredSources
fields.label: "Add to Preferred Sources" Button
fields.description: Google Preferred Sources link shown in the footer and at the top of blog articles.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: e.g. https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=yourdomain.com

fields.name: legalLinks
fields.label: Legal Links
fields.description: Privacy/terms links shown in the footer Resources column and the bottom legal row.

fields.name: agentPages
fields.label: Agent Bio Pages
fields.description: Shared copy on the /about/<name>/ bio pages. Use {name} where the agent's first name should appear; wrap the italic accent phrase in **…**.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Small label above the agent's name (e.g. "Meet your local expert").

fields.name: workHeading
fields.label: Contact Section Heading
fields.description: Heading above the contact ledger, e.g. "Work with **{name} directly.**"

fields.name: leadChips
fields.label: Leading Team Chips
fields.description: Fixed links shown before the teammate chips (e.g. "Full roster").

fields.name: chips
fields.label: Extra Team Chips
fields.description: Fixed links in the teammates chips row (the current agent's teammates are added automatically before these).

fields.name: proof
fields.label: Proof Band
fields.description: The dark metrics band in the middle of every agent bio page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Wrap the accent phrase in **…**.

fields.name: blogPost
fields.label: Blog Article Page
fields.description: Shared copy on /blog/<post>/ article pages.

fields.name: relatedHeading
fields.label: Related Reads Heading
fields.description: Wrap the accent phrase in **…**.

fields.name: ctaTitle
fields.label: Inline CTA Heading
fields.description: The consultation panel at the end of every article.

fields.name: marketTable
fields.label: Market Comparison Table
fields.description: Labels for the "Northwest Houston at a Glance" table shown on the home, buy and sell pages. The rows themselves come from the Communities data table on the Northwest Houston page.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Footer Link URL
fields.description: e.g. /northwest-houston-real-estate/#communities

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation Menu
fields.description: Links shown in the header navigation. Reorder, add, or remove items below. The Site Name shown to the left of these links is set in Site Identity & SEO above.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Link Label
fields.description: The text shown in the nav for this link.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Where this nav item points (e.g. /about or https://example.com).

fields.name: children
fields.label: Dropdown Links
fields.description: Optional. When set, this nav item shows a dropdown of these links instead of being a plain link.

fields.name: children
fields.label: Nested Dropdown Links
fields.description: Optional. Use for neighborhoods or other links grouped under this community.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Any Tabler icon name, e.g. tabler:brand-x, tabler:book-2, tabler:brand-github. Browse at https://icones.js.org/collection/tabler

fields.name: contact
fields.label: Contact Info
fields.description: Office address, phone, and email. Shown in the footer Contact section; the phone also appears in the header top bar.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Office Address
fields.description: One line per address line — lines render separated by a line break.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: Display format, e.g. 713-494-1818. The tel: link is derived from the digits.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Shown in the footer Contact section.

fields.name: footerBlurb

fields.description: Short brokerage/about paragraph shown in the site footer.
